metadata.//: Posts are stored as an array of objects. Each object contains the details of a single post. The date_time field is an array of two strings, the first being the date in DD-MM-YYYY format and the second being the time in 24-hour format. Categories will include (and are limited to) 'Announcement', 'OSM', 'Top Eleven', and 'Other'. Tags are optional and can be used to further categorize posts.

posts.title: Welcome to the new JamieHarperUK Football Management website!
posts.content: I am excited to launch the new website for my Football Management endeavors. Stay tuned for updates and news!

posts.title: New Signing (Dayot Upamecano)
posts.content: Dayot Upamecano has been signed to Manchester United, and will be playing in Centre Back position. Very excited to see what he can bring to the table!

posts.title: New Signing (David Pirie)
posts.content: David Pirie, a new defensive left, has just been signed to Harper FC for a 3 year contract. By all accounts a brilliant Full Back, hopefully shoring up our defensive line.

posts.title: New Signing (Pedro Guedes)
posts.content: Goalkeeper Pedro Guedes has just been signed to Harper FC. He will aim to assist in keeping our goal secure in our upcoming fixtures.

posts.title: Player Transfers
posts.content: Two players have left Harper FC, on to their next adventures at their new clubs. Oak Cadmore was sold for $288K, while Liam Garratt was sold for $420K.

posts.title: New Signing (Marcos Llorente)
posts.content: New defender Marcos Llorente has just been signed to Manchester United. He will aim to assist in our Right Back defensive position.

posts.title: New Signing (Mourad Bouizgar)
posts.content: Mourad Bouizgar has just been signed to Harper FC. The new defender brings new talent to both the Centre and Right defensive lines.

posts.title: Player Transfer
posts.content: Luke Shaw has left Manchester United today, sold to Paris Saint-Germain for $17.5M.

posts.title: Player Transfer
posts.content: Goalkeeper Matthias Vars has left Harper FC, on to his next challenge, sold for $472K.

posts.title: New Signing (Alcidio Feytas)
posts.content: After his temporary loan period, Alcidio Feytas has just been permenantly signed to Harper FC. Follwing his amazing performance so far.

posts.title: Push Notifications Available
posts.content: You can now enable and disable Push Notifications, directly from the Home page, in order to stay up to date with all of the latest posts and updates when they happen.

posts.title: Harper FC Quarter-Final Victory
posts.content: After a gruelling 90 minutes, Harper FC dominated faim FC in a jaw-dropping 7-0 win in the Cup Quarter-Finals! Mahmoud Howash scored a hat-trick with Douence, Marques and Mesquini making up the remaining goals. It was certainly a great game for the team!

posts.title: New Signing (Stanislav Bozhankov)
posts.content: Harper FC welcomes their newest skilled Midfielder Stanislav Bozhankov, signed for a 3 year contract.

posts.title: Player Transfers
posts.content: Goalkeeper Nando Richards-Everton and Striker Arnold Vasiljev have been transferred to other clubs, this comes as Harper FC signs Sergio Moreno da Silva as our new substitute Striker.

posts.title: Player Transfer
posts.content: Another player also makes a move to Paris Saint-Germain. Amad Diallo fetched $20.6M in this transfer.

posts.title: Player Transfer
posts.content: Midfielder Peter Skinner is told for $203K, moments before his next scheduled fixture.

posts.title: Cup Quarter-Finals Victory
posts.content: After two matches (Home and Away), during the Cup Quarter -Finals, and not conceding even 1 goal, Harper FC proceeds through to the Cup Semi-Finals. Fixture schedules to come soon.

posts.title: New Signing (Aymeric Laporte)
posts.content: Manchester United signs Aymeric Laporte as their new Centre Back. Coming from Athletic Bilbao, he has an impressive track record and aims to bolster the Manchester United defence.

posts.title: New Signing (Jorge Manuel Gonzalez)
posts.content: Coming in to bolster efforts across the midfield, Jorge Manuel Gonzalez has just been signed to Harper FC on a 3 season contract.

posts.title: New Club Added
posts.content:
In search of an additional challenge, on top of the two other clubs I'm already managing, I have signed a contract with Altrincham FC. That league is due to start on July 29th, and so preparation begins. 

Player transfers for Altrincham FC, made prior to the league starting, won't be published. Instead the squad list will simply be updated accordingly.

posts.title: Player Transfer
posts.content: Lisandro Martinez makes an exciting move to Barcelona from Manchester United, with a transfer fee of $17.6M, as his teammates wish him well.

posts.title: Player Transfer
posts.content: Chris Brewer is transferred from Harper FC for $497K. The 23 year old English striker said he was sad to go, but excited for the next chapter in his career.

posts.title: Player Transfer
posts.content: Steven Matthews, the 24 year old midfielder, has been transferred from Harper FC for $368K.

posts.title: Harper FC Stadium Renamed
posts.content: Harper FC have renamed their home stadium to 'The Concourse'. The renaming marks a new chapter for the club and its fans.

posts.title: Player Transfer
posts.content: Harry Maguire, Manchester United right back, has transferred to Paris Saint-Germain with a transfer fee of $19.0M.

posts.title: Weekly Round-up
posts.content:
Welcome to the first weekly round-up. In future I will aim to post these on Sundays, ahead of the next week and recapping the week prior. 

Over the past week I have continued to manage Manchester United (OSM), landing the club in 2nd place in the league, 11 point behind Liverpool FC and leading 1 point ahead of Newcastle United. The board has stated they're aiming for a minimum of 6th place, so we are well ahead of board expectations, with our next match against Arsenal hopefully only increasing our lead. 

Harper FC (Top Eleven) has had an eventful week, renaming our home turn ‘The Concourse’ and rebranding with a new club emblem and team kits, the fans have also taken to calling themselves ‘The Vanguard’. The team itself is on phenomenal form too, winning our last 4 League games by large margins from 4 to 9 goals without conceding any goals in return. In addition to the League games, we have also played 2 Cup games winning both and advancing through to the Cup Semi-Finals. The first of the Semi-Finals games will be played on July 29th, and we’re expecting the winning streak to continue. 

Finally I have also picked up management of Altrincham FC (OSM), and are currently in pre-season preparations with the squad at the moment, the first game of the season expected to be against FC Gateshead also on July 29th. 

Stay tuned to my Twitter (I refuse to call it ‘X’) - @JamieHarperUK – for more updates, and screenshots. And of course do let me know via Twitter if these weekly updates are welcome or not. 

Have a great week everyone!

posts.title: Player Transfer
posts.content: Mason Mount makes a surprising move to Atletico Madrid from Manchester United, with a transfer fee of $20.0M, apparently happy to see the back of his now former club.

posts.title: New Signing (Arnaud Bedime)
posts.content: Reinforcing Harper FC's defensive line, Arnaud Bedime has just been signed on a 3 season contract for $1.07M, outbidding 7 other clubs.

posts.title: Player Transfers
posts.content: Defender Frankie Peach and Midfielder Jody Horlock have been transferred to other clubs as of  today. Frankie was sold for $430K while Jody fetched $402K, allowing for a somewhat healthy cash injection to Harper FC.

posts.title: Jensen Weir Injury
posts.content: The Altrincham FC midfielder Jensen Weir received a serious injury in his last game against Woking. The club doctor estimates he will be unavailable to play in the next 7 to 8 games while he recovers.

posts.title: New Signing (Rattasak Saiwaew)
posts.content: Rattasak Saiwaew has just been signed to Harper FC, in order to fill a midfield position left by the surprise single match suspension of Stanislav Bozhankov. Although Bozhankov is expected to return to the field immediately after his suspension, there is quite the excitement at the club surrounding Saiwaew's reported skill and subsequent prospects of becoming a regular in the team's starting eleven going forward.

posts.title: New Signing (Louis Mafouta)
posts.content: Altrincham FC has picked up the striker Louis Mafouta for $4.0M from the French club En Avant Guingamp, further reinforcing the club's offensive line.

posts.title: Weekly Round-up
posts.content:
Happy weekend everyone, that's right it's time for our weekly round-up.

This week Manchester United (OSM), has unexpectedly dropped to 3rd place in the league, being overtaken by Newcastle United following a draw against Arsenal on Tuesday. We also managed to come away from the league cup semi-final with a 3-0 win against Tottenham Hotspur, meaning that we are through to the final and will face off against Brighton and Hove Albion on 11-08-2026 for the cup.

Harper FC (Top Eleven) has also had another eventful week. The team is on peak form, winning the Cup Quarter-Finals AND Semi-Finals without conceding a single goal, advancing us through to the Final against one 'FC ransonet' on 04-08-2026. In addition Harper FC is also topping the league table too, with a 5 point lead on the second place team ('sambono5 FC'). I fully expect the winning streak to continue too.

Finally Altrincham FC have had a great start to their league run, winning their first 3 games and coming away with a draw in yesterday's game against Harrogate Town, and placing 2nd in the league table. As the league's Preliminaries are being played today, and Altrincham FC has no fixtures, the team is completely focused on training ahead of their next game against AFC Fylde on Monday.

I would also like to note that I have updated the site notifications / alerts now (along with this shiny new domain name) to update subscribed users with match results as they become available. If you're interested, just click the 'Alerts' button in the bottom right of the site to ensure they are enabled for you.

As always, stay tuned to my Twitter (I refuse to call it ‘X’) - @JamieHarperUK – for more updates, and highlights. And of course do let me know via Twitter if these weekly updates are welcome or not. 

Have a great week everyone!

posts.title: New Signing (Lamine Yamal)
posts.content: Manchester United has made a bombshell signing of Lamine Yamal Nasroui Ebana for their newest Right Back. Arriving from Juventus, the deal was solidified by the whopping $60.2M transfer fee that came with it.

posts.title: New Signing (Maximiliano Martinones)
posts.content:
Maximiliano Martinones has just been signed to Harper FC. This $1.44M signing comes off the back of numerous negotiations, and the outbidding of 7 other clubs.

Martinones is slated to replace Mark Robertson in his midfield position, with Robertson saying he welcomes the break after a number of games played in succession, though he will be on the bench to support should it become necessary.

posts.title: Jensen Weir is Back
posts.content:
After being expected to sit out the next 7 to 8 games, Jensen Weir has just received the 'all clear' from the club doctors after a remarkably speedy recovery.

While it is still unclear if he will be in the starting eleven against Altrincham FC's next game against AFC Fylde, he is fighting fit and will at very least be on the bench ready to jump in if called upon.

posts.title: Player Transfer
posts.content:
Francis McPolin has said goodbye to Harper FC, in a transfer deal worth $225K.

The right attacking midfielder said he was excited to finally get some play time at his new club, having been sat in reserve for the majority of the season already.

posts.title: Double Hat-trick
posts.content:
A stellar performance this morning in Harper FC's League match against ammar FC, walking away with an unfathomable 6-0 victory. Though that wasn't the most impressive part about the game.

Two players actually managed to bag a hat-trick EACH, making up the total 6 goals. Rachid Mesquini was able to cap off his 3 goals in the 40th minute (putting his total goals this season now 17 in 14 matches), whilst the clubs newest signing Maximiliano Martinones put away his 3rd goal in the 65th minute.

Martinones makes a phenomenal 2nd match appearance, having not contributed any goals in yesterday's match against Tralee, it could be argued that he has more than made up for it. With a Cup final match scheduled for 10PM GMT tonight, there is the hope that this performance can continue uninterrupted.

posts.title: Cup Victory
posts.content:
What a night for the club, as Harper FC lifts its very first trophy after an unforgettable performance in the final.

We went head-to-head against FC ransonet, expecting a tough battle on the pitch. Instead, the squad put on a masterclass from the first whistle until the last, securing a massive 8-0 win to claim the silverware.

Special praise goes to our star player Rachid Mesquini, who led the charge in style by netting 4 of the goals by himself. Every single player fought hard, dominated possession, and made this dream a reality.

posts.title: New Club Added
posts.content:
Once again I've taken up yet another Club's management, this time on the popular football management platform known as Hattrick.

Today we say hello to the newly established Cheshire Harriers FC! It is worth noting that Hattrick is a lot more involved that both Top Eleven and Online Soccer Manager, but I'm excited to dive right in and start building the club and team.

As always, stay tuned for fixture results and other updates right here on this site. Ensure you have 'Alerts' turned on to get all of the latest results and news as they develop.

posts.content:
Jorge Manuel Gonzalez, the Harper FC right midfielder, has been sold for $802K on the transfer list.

When asked for comment Gonzalez declined to comment, but it was clear that he was already packed and on his way out of the door.

posts.title: New Signing (Tomi Sauvala)
posts.content:
Tomi Sauvala has just been signed to Cheshire Harriers FC for £1,203. The 27 year old is to come in and bolster the midfield ahead of Sunday's match against TheTrueSasAcademy.

Sauvala is reportedly quite the playmaker, although has had problems operating on the wings. No doubt these will all be things addressed in upcoming training sessions.

posts.content:

The insane performance by the squad just reinforced the claiming of the top spot in the league, and provided a well deserved morale boost to such a hard working squad.
